claim: The Karnataka VAHAN compilation has 36,198 rows for 67 RTOs over 57 months (2022-01 to 2026-09).
caveat: Monthly new registrations (flows), not vehicle stock.
BEV = Electric(BOV) + Pure EV as published; hybrids are separate. The latest year is partial.

claim: The highest monthly battery-EV registrations were 29,665 in 2026-07.
Largest RTOs by 2025 battery-EV registrations: KA5 Bengaluru South RTO 11.0%; KA2 Bengaluru West RTO 6.9%; KA3 Bengaluru East RTO 6.7%; KA1 Bengaluru Central RTO 6.6%; KA51 Electronic City RTO 6.0%.
caveat: RTO of registration, not where vehicles are used or charged. RTO names are not evidence of district membership.

claim: The BEE location-wise list has 8,246 Karnataka rows (8,512 connectors); 8,232 have valid coordinates; they form 6,056 candidate sites.
caveat: Installed, not operational: 0 rows have an operating status. Licence not stated. Extracted from a PDF; no official spreadsheet to compare with.

claim: A manual Stage 3 extraction of the same BEE PDF gave 6,113 Karnataka records. It is incomplete: 2,349 S18 rows have no match by coordinates, 216 Stage 3 rows have no coordinates and 0 Stage 3 rows are absent from S18.
derivation: Coordinate multiset match, Stage 3 file sha256 b56e589eb7cb
caveat: Do not cite the Stage 3 count; use the S18 figures.

claim: MHI (Lok Sabha written reply, PIB, 16 Dec 2025): 6,096 EV charging stations installed in Karnataka during the last five years (751 fast, 5,345 slow). PIB annexure with Ministry of Power inputs (file dated Aug 2025): 6,097 public EV charging stations installed.
derivation: Values transcribed from official documents (register S03, S17)
caveat: Stations, not BEE list rows or connectors; different dates and definitions; fast/slow not defined on the page. Not forced to match S18.

claim: OpenStreetMap has 67 charging-station records in Karnataka; 17 are within 100 m of a BEE site.
caveat: OSM is incomplete for chargers; used as a secondary layer.

claim: BEE rows by district (point in Census 2011 district polygon, mapped to the LGD code): 8,232 rows; 30 of 31 districts have at least one row; the largest are Bengaluru Urban 6,352; Bengaluru Rural 203; Dakshina Kannada 165.
caveat: Charger location is a point, so district assignment is valid for supply. Census 2011 polygons: rows in Vijayanagara are counted in Ballari (the 2011 polygon includes it). Stated and point districts disagree for 247 rows; the point is used.

claim: 0 of 67 RTOs have a verified district.
caveat: A row becomes verified only with an LGD code, jurisdiction basis, source URL and retrieval date. Office names and addresses are not jurisdiction evidence.

claim: Battery-EV registrations by district are not computable.
caveat: Registrations are by RTO; they are not split by population, area or name.

claim: Registrations per charger by district, and any district gap ranking that uses registrations, are not computable.
derivation: Depends on the district demand claim above
caveat: Gap analysis can be shown at state level, or with supply-only district indicators.
